assay: bulk RNA-seq (poly-A, NextSeq 550, 75bp SE), tibialis anterior, STAR GeneCounts
exercise_factor: none: no exercise intervention or exercise arm; exercise capacity (treadmill, voluntary wheel) was only measured as part of the CFAB function score on all mice (S2.2.p1)
sample_inclusion: n=7 6m, 7 24m, 8 28m (one 6m and one 24m RNA failed QC); 6m libraries prepared twice, once per run, technical replicates kept separate (S2.3.p2, S2.4.p1)
primary_estimand: age effect on TA gene expression (28m vs 6m within run2; 24m vs 6m within run1), then association of DEG expression with CFAB functional score (S3.2.p2)
repeated_measure_unit: none for biology (one TA per mouse); 6m mice sequenced in both runs
normalization: DESeq2 size factors; rlog for PCA/heatmap (S3.1.1.p2)
requested_estimand: effect of exercise on gene expression
requested_estimand_in_paper: not_reported (no exercise contrast; exercise appears only as a functional test and in discussion of external exercise datasets, S5.8.p2)
